title: Corrigendum to "Higher Lorentzian polynomials,...in codimension two" [International Mathematics Research Notices, Volume 2025, Issue 13, July 2025, arXiv:2208.05653]
summary: A homogeneous bivariate $d$-form defines an $(i+1)$-rowed Toeplitz matrix for each $i$ between $0$ and $d$. We use Hodge theory and Schur polynomials to prove that if the $(i+1)$-rowed Toeplitz matrix of a form is totally nonnegative, then so is the $i$-rowed one. This fixes a gap in the main result of paper above.
